questions.stem: This _______ requires dairy milk, but you can use soy milk as a substitute.

解析: a. booklet 小冊子 b. manual 手冊 c. pattern 模式 d. recipe 食譜 句
意:_______需要牛乳，但您可以用豆漿代替。 依據句意答案選擇 d
substitute.(n.) a thing that takes the place or function of another If you like,
you can use nuts as a substitute for coconut in that recipe

questions.stem: _______ a handy gadget it is! Is it expensive?
questions.explain:
句意: 多麼便利的一個小器具? 這器具很貴嗎? 依照句意選 b 解析: What + n.!
表感嘆句，結尾用「！」 What a/an +（形容詞）+單數名詞！ e.g. What an
inspiring talk! 真是激勵人心的演講啊！ e.g. What a lovely day! 今天真美好
啊！ e.g. What a surprise! 太驚訝了! 要特別注意的是，中間的形容詞可以省
略，但最後面的名詞則是一定要有的。 * How+形容詞+（主詞+動詞）！也可
表感嘆句 How的後面固定是接形容詞，跟What不同，What接名詞。口氣來
得比What…！來口語。 e.g. How adorable (the baby is)! 這寶寶真可愛！

questions.stem: In most situations, water _______ if the temperature drops below zero degrees Celsius.
questions.explain:
句意: 在大部分狀況下，假如溫度降到低於攝氏零度， 水就會結冰。依照句意
選 d 單字解析: a. hisses 發嘶嘶聲；發噓聲 b. sneezes 打噴嚏 c. pisses 尿，
小便 d. freezes （使）凍結，（使）結冰

questions.stem: When I was in the army, I could not stand _______ “Shorty.”
questions.explain:
解析:: 當我當兵時，我受不了被稱為“ 矮子”。 Call 這裡要用被動式 stand 後
面 +N 或ving, 所以答案選c Stand (v.) to successfully accept or bear
something that is unpleasant or difficult 承受住，經受住 Our tent won't stand
another storm like the last one.

questions.stem: After Ted posted a TikTok video of himself mimicking Donald Trump, it went _______.
questions.explain:
句意: 在Ted po出他自己模仿川普影片在抖音上後， 影片如病毒式的傳開(爆
紅)。依照句意選 a 解析: a. Something go(es) viral.: 病毒式的傳開(爆紅) b.
local當地的 c. moral道德的 (adj.) d. focal中心的；重要的 (adj.)

questions.stem: We are still in the dark about _______ the magician vanished into thin air.
questions.explain:
句意: 我們仍渾然不知這魔術師怎麼完全消失在空中。依照句意選 d 單字解
析: be.v. in the dark: to not know about something that other people know
about 蒙在鼓裡，渾然不知; vanish (v.): to disappear or stop being present or
existing, especially in a sudden, surprising way （尤指突然）消失，滅絕;
vanish into thin air: to disappear suddenly and completely: 突然且完全消失
文法解析: how: in what way, or by what methods 如何，怎麼。所以選d

questions.stem: Deserts are dry, desolate places, with some exceptions: oases. An oasis is created by an underground water source known as an aquifer. Oases may develop from a water supply such as a natural spring that bubbles up, or it could be the result of man-made wells that force the water to the surface. Some of these wells are ancient and have been well protected over the years because they are so valuable to the existence of crops and other vegetation. Strong palm trees are commonly planted around oases to protect them from sandstorms that could seriously damage them. Why are palm trees usually planted around an oasis?

options.A: To add to the beauty of the oasis.
options.B: To protect the crops and other vegetation there.
options.C: To safeguard the oasis from harm.

questions.explain:
解析:…Strong palm trees are commonly planted around oases to protect
them from sandstorms that could seriously damage them.通常在綠洲周圍種
上堅固的棕櫚樹，以保護綠洲避免遭受沙塵暴可能帶來的嚴重破壞 題目:為什
麼通常在綠洲周圍種植棕櫚樹？依據上下文 答案選c. 維護綠洲免受傷害。
aquifer (n.) a layer of rock, sand, or earth that contains water or allows water
to pass through it 含水土層，地下蓄水層，砂石含水層

questions.stem: Wikipedia is an online encyclopedia that was founded in 2003 by Jimmy Wales. Before Wikipedia, there was Nupedia, which allowed people to submit articles that would be edited by experts. However, this system was not satisfactory. In the first year of operation, Nupedia only published 21 articles. Wikipedia founder Jimmy Wales decided to try out new software called wiki. This system allowed lots of people to edit online articles at the same time. It worked remarkably well, and the site grew rapidly. Volunteers keep the site working under some key operating policies. One important policy is that articles should not take sides on sensitive issues. That is, Wikipedia strives to be neutral. Today, Wikipedia is the most widely used online reference work in the world. Which expression best explains the word "neutral" in the passage?
questions.explain:
解析:.... Volunteers keep the site working under some key operating policies.
One important policy is that articles should not take sides on sensitive
issues. That is, Wikipedia strives to be neutral. 志工透過一些關鍵操作政策讓
網站正常運行。一項重要政策是，文章在敏感問題上不表態。 也就是說，維
基百科努力保持中立。依據上下文 答案選c. Neither for nor against. 既不贊成
也不反對。 Neutral (adj.) not saying or doing anything that would encourage
or help any of the groups involved in an argument or war 中立的，不偏不倚
的 The peace conference would have to be held in a neutral country.

questions.stem: In November 2020, Time announced its first-ever Kid of the Year, in recognition of upcoming leaders among the US's youngest generation. The magazine named 15-year-old scientist and inventor Gitanjali Rao the award's first recipient. Rao's inventions have included a device for detecting lead in water and an app that recognizes instances of cyberbullying. Rao was selected out of more than 5,000 US nominees, and the pool was narrowed down to five finalists who have all contributed to their communities in astonishing ways. All five finalists were featured in the magazine and received prize money. What was an invention that Rao worked on?

options.A: A machine that can grow crops with less water.
options.B: A device that filters harmful chemicals out of water.
options.C: A gadget that can test water for the presence of a metal.
options.D: A device that translates what people say into other languages.

questions.explain:
解析:….Rao's inventions have included a device for detecting lead in water
and an app that recognizes instances of cyberbullying. Rao的發明包括用於
檢測水中鉛的設備和可識別網絡欺凌實例的應用程式。題目: Rao從事的發明
是什麼？依據上下文 答案選c. 可以測試水中是否存在金屬的小工具。 Device
(n.) an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose 裝
置，器械 Rescuers used a special device for finding people trapped in
collapsed buildings.
